title: Ecgberht structured receipt
description: Structured receipts for soft-vet/grasscatch/depth/handback/override/heartbeat/seen/commission_abnormal/seat_hop/face_confirm. Monologue-only invalid. W4: override requires who/when/why/from→to; depth requires tool_depth_why; soft-vet carries deferred/why/suggested_later_owner/uncertainty_flags. W5: handback requires active_effort, why_next, grasscatch_why (nullable), tool_depth_why, human_wait, uncertainty_flags array. TW2: seen is the brief delta anchor and requires who/when/altitude (project|portfolio). TW3 (M2): commission_abnormal is the abnormal job-exit receipt (crash/timeout/kill/orphan/reap) and requires who/when/last_known_state/why_known — a dead terminal must never persist as silent green. TW4: seat_hop is the non-event seat-switch transition document and requires who/when/from→to (seat families claude|gemini|grok; next turn continues from Face/Strip/Roadmap/packet with no re-brief); face_confirm is the Face-only 'Still the goal' acknowledgement and requires who/when.

as_of.description: ISO date or datetime of the receipt

tool_depth_why.description: Why the dispatch table (or human override) chose this depth cell

uncertainty_flags.description: Uncertainty / capacity flags carried on soft-vet/depth/handback receipts

suggested_later_owner.description: Suggested later owner for deferred work (soft-vet/grasscatch/handback)

capacity.description: Capacity signal snapshot (known|unknown) on depth receipts

who.description: Who viewed the brief (seen receipts) / who observed the terminal (commission_abnormal)

when.description: When the brief was viewed / terminal was observed (ISO date or datetime)

last_known_state.description: Last known lifecycle state before the abnormal exit (commission_abnormal; M2 lifecycle queued|running)

why_known.description: How the abnormal terminal is known (kill signal, non-zero exit, timeout, out-of-process liveness evidence)

terminal.description: Observed terminal state on commission_abnormal receipts (failed|orphaned|reaped)

step_id.description: Roadmap step the commissioned job was bound to (commission_abnormal receipts)

from.description: Seat family before the hop (seat_hop receipts: claude|gemini|grok)

to.description: Seat family after the hop (seat_hop receipts: claude|gemini|grok)

goal.description: Goal text acknowledged on face_confirm receipts (Still the goal)

confirmed.description: face_confirm receipts: the goal was confirmed unchanged

override.description: Human override of dispatch outcome requires who/when/why/from→to
